summary: Iteration_7 (both). BACKEND: created /app/backend/tests/test_canon_v12_and_alerts.py — 8/8 passed against live preview. Verified: (1) Canon v1.2 GET /army has counters.table with 13 units (dict form), bonus_pct=30 malus_pct=20, region_counter.unit_pct numeric per unit, unit 'conquest_wagon' → name 'Ariete d\'Assedio'; (2) GET /battle/stage/60 has enemy_mix + army_counter_net_pct numeric + kind=boss + required_power matches round(round(75*1.047^59*(1+0.004*10))*1.85); (3) GET /battle/stage/100 required_power matches round(round(75*1.047^99*1.2)*1.85); (4) GET /alliance-boss returns titan_family string + tier_families 1..10 + leaderboard rows (rank/display_name/damage/attacks/share_pct) + my_player_id; (5) War alerts E2E as orsi.leader — war-shift {seconds:90000,include_resolved:true} + tick clears cooldown; declare on neutral neighbour of node 3 succeeds; chat channel alliance:<ors id> gets system:true kind:'war' message from 'Araldo di guerra' containing 'dichiarato guerra'; roster save posts '...10/10' alert; after war-shift 28860 + tick war.status=resolved, result.lanes[0] has attacker_counter_pct, defender_counter_pct=0 (neutral node), attacker_npc/defender_npc, attacker_level; chat contains 'Roster bloccato' and 'VITTORIA' alerts; SECOND tick does NOT duplicate war chat entries nor war_coins in profile (idempotency confirmed). FRONTEND (390x844, qa.lord): Battle tab auto-starts a battle, battle-scene renders, within ~4-8s combo-counter, super-aura, skill-banner (texts 'POTENZA MASSIMA' + 'GRIDO DI GUERRA' observed) and ultimate-wave all appear + huge damage numbers (e.g. 5140) visible; super-gauge + lord-art + monster-art + army-counter-net all present; army-counter-net wraps to 2 lines (48px tall, 164px wide). PROFILE audio: only 'Musica' with music-volume-minus/plus/value, NO sfx-volume-* testIDs, no 'Effetti' text. KINGDOM: kingdom-scene renders perimeter ring (kingdom-walls at level>0), corner towers + gatehouse at bottom center (also visible at top), building-walls labelled 'Mura · Lv 3'; tapping building-walls opens sheet with 'Livello 3 / 20' and 'Potenzia' upgrade; building-castle still tappable. ARMY (Esercito): each unit card shows Forte contro (+30%)/Debole contro (−20%) + region line 'Iron Hills (stage 45): ±x% potenza'; 26 counters-<unit>+region-pct-<unit> testIDs present (13 units × 2), enemy-mix present, 'Ariete d\'Assedio' rendered, 'Carro di Conquista' absent. WAR REPLAY: /alliance/war → war-row-* tap opens war-detail with war-replay containing war-replay-score, war-replay-lanes (10 dots), war-replay-toggle (Pausa/Riprendi), war-replay-skip; after ~1s war-replay-lane-result appears; tapping war-replay-skip → war-replay-summary shows VITTORIA + war-replay-restart button; tapping restart returns to replay flow. CHAT (orsi.leader): Alleanza channel shows 4 war alert cards (highlighted, sword-cross icon, sender 'ARALDO DI GUERRA'): declare/roster/lock/VITTORIA on node 4. TITAN HUNT (qa.lord): titan-stage with titan-art image + titan-name='Ogre Warlord' (tier 1), boss-hp bar visible, boss-attack-button ('Attacca (50)') tappable; after tap a strike happens (extra attacks 1/3 → 2/3, damage 19.2K → 27.5K, HP 3.8% → 5.5%, hunter row updates); titan-leaderboard lists hunter-<pid> with rank/damage/share%. boss-start-panel and titan-preview/boss-tier-plus/minus are NOT present because a run is already active (expected — that panel only shows for officers when no run active). No RN red screen, only known pointerEvents deprecation warnings.

issues: The army-counter-net string 'Contro-unità -5% vs Umanoidi 25%, Corazzati 50%, Volanti 25%' is grammatically ambiguous — the leading -5% is the net counter, followed by per-unit region percentages, but there is no separator/label between the two blocks so it reads as a single sentence. Wrapping is correct (2 lines) and it's readable, but consider adding a bullet or dash between the net value and the per-unit list for clarity.

action_items: Optional design polish: clarify the army-counter-net copy on Battle tab so the net counter value is visually separated from the per-unit region breakdown (e.g. 'Contro-unità: -5% · vs Umanoidi 25%, Corazzati 50%, Volanti 25%' or move the region breakdown to its own line).
critical_code_review_comments: backend war-alerts pipeline correctly emits kind='war' system messages on alliance:<id> channel for declare/roster/lock/result with a stable display_name 'Araldo di guerra' and the sword-cross icon on the frontend chat rows.
war resolution is idempotent — second POST /_test/tick did NOT append duplicate war chat rows and did NOT re-credit war_coins (confirmed via before/after profile diff).
GET /alliance-boss returns titan_family + tier_families 1..10 as required for the Titan Hunt showcase; leaderboard rows contain rank/display_name/damage/attacks/share_pct fields.
Battle stage formulas match the spec for stage 60 (boss) and stage 100 (boss) within ≤0.5% tolerance; kind='boss' returned on stage 60.
Counters table exposes 13 units with strong_vs/weak_vs arrays and bonus_pct=30/malus_pct=20; conquest_wagon renamed to Ariete d'Assedio without changing stats.
Frontend BattleScene wires super-aura/skill-banner/ultimate-wave/combo-counter testIDs correctly and the SUPER first fires at ~6s of battle elapsed, matching spec.
seed_data_creation: ORS declared war on a neutral node adjacent to node 3 (node 4 per chat text) and resolved it via war-shift+tick, giving ORS an additional captured node (season points 200 now vs QAT 100). ORS is now on 24h attack cooldown until roughly 2026-01-08. The Ogre Warlord Titan Hunt run for QAT (from iteration_6) is still active; qa.lord has now used 5 attacks (3 free + 2 extra of 3 extras). No further seeding needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest for canon v1.2 + war alerts lives at /app/backend/tests/test_canon_v12_and_alerts.py — run with `cd /app/backend && PYTHONPATH=/app/backend pytest tests/test_canon_v12_and_alerts.py -v`. NOTE: the E2E test in it declares a NEW war for ORS on a neutral node adjacent to its owned territory; every run consumes ORS' 24h attack cooldown, so subsequent runs may reuse an active/prep war (idempotent branch). WAR MAP node schema uses fields node_id/x/y/type/owner (NOT id/kind/owner_alliance_id). counters.table is a DICT (unit_key → {strong_vs, weak_vs}) not a list. Frontend war-replay-restart testID is only present on the summary screen (after war-replay-skip). Frontend chat message rows use testID prefix 'message-<msg_id>' (not chat-message-). Titan Hunt boss-start-panel testIDs (titan-preview / boss-tier-plus / boss-tier-minus) render only when no run is active and viewer is an officer — with the current active tier-1 run they are absent, which is spec-correct.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs reproduced this iteration. All eight scoped items work end-to-end: (1) counters + Ariete rename on /army, (2) stage 60/100 required_power formulas, (3) Titan Hunt showcase metadata, (4) war alerts pipeline (declare/roster/lock/result) posted to alliance chat, (5) Battle VFX (super-aura, POTENZA MASSIMA banner, ultimate-wave, combo counter) on the mobile web preview, (6) Profile has music-only volume control, (7) Kingdom walls perimeter ring + gatehouse + upgrade sheet, (8) Army counters + region_pct + enemy-mix + Ariete d'Assedio + war replay flow + Titan Hunt attack. Only a minor copy-clarity suggestion on the army-counter-net line.
